title: Hidex Libray. BASICC
script:
-- Create by Havens Studio
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cat558-uz/Libray/refs/heads/main/Ikk"))()

local Window = Library:CreateWindow("Hidex Client")

local home = Window:CreateTab("Home","rbxassetid://10723407389")
local Main = Window:CreateTab("Main","rbxassetid://7734053495")
local Farm = Window:CreateTab("Farm","rbxassetid://10723407335")

local Profile = home:CreateScreen(
    "perfil seu",
    "Bem vindo!"
)

local Info = home:CreateParagraph(
    "Bem vindo",
    "Mensagem.\nBem Vindo A Hidex Client Otimize seu jogo."
)

local Discord = home:CreateDiscordInvite(
    "Havens studio",
    "https://discord.gg/FNneTEfxtf",
    "rbxassetid://1234567890"
)

Discord:SetText("Havens Studio K")
Discord:SetLink("https://discord.gg/FNneTEfxtf")
Discord:SetLogo("rbxassetid://134099804489248")

Main:CreateButton("Destroy Gui","",function()
    Window:DestroyGui()
end)

Main:CreateButton("Corner 1","",function()
    Window:SetCorner(1)
end)

Main:CreateSection("Player")

local SpeedSlider = Main:CreateSlider("WalkSpeed",16,300,16,function(v)
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = v
end)

local Box = Main:CreateTextbox("Username","Digite seu nome...",function(text,enter)
    Window:Notify("Textbox","Texto: "..text)
end)

Box:SetText("Ghost")
Box:SetPlaceholder("Novo placeholder")

local Drop = Main:CreateDropdown("Escolha",{
    "Speed",
    "Jump",
    "Fly",
    "Noclip"
},function(v)
    Window:Notify("Selecionado",v)
end)

Drop:Add("Player1")
Drop:Add("Player2")
Drop:Remove("Player1")

Main:CreateButton("Example Button","rbxassetid://7733715400",function()
    Window:Notify("System","Button Clicked")
end)

Main:CreateToggle("WalkSpeed","",false,function(v)
    Window:Notify("Toggle","WalkSpeed "..tostring(v))
end)

Main:CreateToggle("icone toggle","rbxassetid://7733715400",false,function(v)
end)

Farm:CreateSection("Farm")
Farm:CreateSection2("Farm 2")

Farm:CreateButton("Start Farm","",function()
    Window:SetTitle("Farming...")
    Window:Notify("Farm","Farm Started")
end)
